title: Halal Muslim Themed Endless Runner Game (Subway Surfers Style)

requirements.text: Implement a 3D endless runner core gameplay loop using React Three Fiber: the player character automatically runs forward along a three-lane track, can swipe/press left or right to change lanes, jump (up arrow / swipe up) to clear obstacles, and slide (down arrow / swipe down) to go under obstacles. The game ends when the player collides with an obstacle.

quotes: Create a game like Subway surf with halal muslim theme

acceptanceCriteria: Player character runs forward automatically at increasing speed over time
Left/right lane switching works via keyboard arrow keys and touch swipe
Jump and slide animations play correctly on input
Collision with obstacle triggers a game-over state
Game speed gradually increases the longer the player survives

requirements.text: Build procedurally generated 3D Islamic-themed environments that scroll toward the player: include mosque architecture (minarets, domes, arched doorways), geometric tile patterns on floors and walls, crescent moon and star decorations, and desert/market bazaar scenery. Environments should tile seamlessly for an infinite feel.
acceptanceCriteria: Track environment visually evokes Islamic architecture and art
Environment tiles loop seamlessly without visible seams
Geometric Arabic patterns appear on floor/wall surfaces
Minaret and dome silhouettes appear in the background

requirements.text: Add coin and collectible mechanics: scatter golden coins (styled as Islamic gold dinars with crescent motifs) and special collectibles (e.g., prayer beads, lanterns, Quran scrolls) along the three lanes. Collecting items increments the run score. Display a coin counter and score on the HUD.

quotes: Create a game like Subway surf

acceptanceCriteria: Coins and collectibles appear along all three lanes during a run
Touching/running through a coin increments the coin counter
Score increases continuously based on distance run and items collected
HUD displays current coin count and distance score in real time

requirements.text: Implement Islamic-themed power-ups that the player can collect during a run: a 'Barakah Shield' that grants temporary invincibility, a 'Buraq Boost' for a speed burst with a flying visual effect, and a 'Magnet' that auto-collects nearby coins. Each power-up has a visible timer on the HUD while active.

quotes: Create a game like Subway surf with halal muslim theme

acceptanceCriteria: Three distinct power-up types spawn randomly during a run
Each power-up has a unique 3D icon with Islamic styling
Active power-up duration is shown in the HUD with a depleting bar
Shield makes player invincible to one obstacle collision
Buraq Boost temporarily increases speed and shows a visual trail

requirements.text: Create a character selection screen with at least three selectable Muslim-themed runner characters (e.g., a boy in a kufi cap, a girl in a hijab, a scholar with a turban). Selected character persists across runs. Characters are rendered as simple 3D mesh figures with culturally appropriate clothing.
acceptanceCriteria: Character selection screen shows at least three character options
Each character has a visually distinct appearance with Islamic attire
Selected character is highlighted and saved for the current session
The chosen character model appears correctly in the game run

requirements.text: Implement a persistent high score leaderboard stored in the Motoko backend: save each completed run's score and coin count associated with a player nickname. Display the top 10 scores on a leaderboard screen accessible from the main menu. Provide a 'Submit Score' flow after game over.

quotes: Create a game like Subway surf

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores run records with nickname, score, and coin count
Leaderboard screen fetches and displays the top 10 all-time scores
After game over, player can enter a nickname and submit their score
Scores are ranked in descending order
Leaderboard updates immediately after a new score is submitted

requirements.text: Design a cohesive visual theme: use a warm desert color palette (sand golds, terracotta, deep teal, ivory) with Arabic calligraphy-inspired typography for headings. Apply the Islamic geometric pattern motifs consistently across the main menu, HUD, character select, and leaderboard screens. All UI must feel immersive and culturally respectful.
acceptanceCriteria: Color palette is consistently warm desert tones across all screens
Headings use a decorative Arabic-inspired or calligraphy-style font
Islamic geometric patterns appear as borders or backgrounds in UI panels
No culturally disrespectful or haram imagery appears anywhere in the game

requirements.text: Create a main menu screen with the game logo, a Play button, a Character Select button, and a Leaderboard button. Include a game-over screen showing the run's final score, coins collected, best score, and buttons to Retry or Return to Menu.

quotes: Create a game like Subway surf

acceptanceCriteria: Main menu displays game title/logo and all three navigation buttons
Game-over screen shows final score, coins, and personal best
Retry immediately starts a new run
Return to Menu navigates back to the main menu
Transitions between screens are smooth

constraints: All game logic and rendering must run entirely on the frontend using React Three Fiber / Three.js
No external game engines (Unity, Unreal, Phaser) may be used
All imagery and content must be culturally respectful of Islamic values — no haram elements
Backend is limited to score persistence only; all gameplay logic stays on the frontend
nonGoals: Audio or music (no sound implementation required)
